# 05-final-validation: Full solution build and test suite

## Objective

Perform a full solution build to confirm all 10 projects compile cleanly on net10.0. Run the complete test suite and ensure all tests pass.

## Scope

All 10 projects — validation only, no code changes expected.

## Done when

- `dotnet build eShopOnWeb.sln` succeeds with 0 errors and 0 warnings
- All unit and integration tests pass
- `dotnet test` exits with code 0
